mapper.select: SELECT sm.org_id, sm.se_id, sm.pkg_no, sm.out_country, sm.addr_no, sm.pkg_qty, sm.chk_date, sm.status AS pkg_status, sd.se_seq, sd.color, sd.art_name, im.status AS item_status, om.po, om.crea_user, om.crea_date, dm.cust_name AS custNm FROM se_pkg_m sm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT org_id, pkg_no, MIN(se_seq) se_seq, MIN(color) color, MIN(art_name) art_name FROM se_pkg_d GROUP BY org_id, pkg_no ) sd ON sm.org_id = sd.org_id AND sm.pkg_no = sd.pkg_no LEFT JOIN se_ord_item im ON im.org_id = sm.org_id AND im.se_id = sm.se_id AND im.se_seq = sd.se_seq LEFT JOIN se_ord_m om ON om.org_id = sm.org_id AND om.se_id = sm.se_id WHERE sm.last_date >= #{sTime} AND sm.last_date < #{eTime} AND sm.org_id = #{orgId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM se_pack_m x WHERE x.org_id = sm.org_id AND x.pkg_no = sm.pkg_no AND x.status = 7) ORDER BY sm.last_date DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
